assessments.reasoning: OSI CMS record 406 matches the claimed digest, is typed license and titled “The Open Software License 3.0.” It calls for “Licensed under the Open Software License version 3.0” adjacent to the copyright notice and sets out the grant.
The Index owns its data model and admits a controlling publication with an identifiable edition and grant. Ordinary OSL 3.0 meets that criterion for the intended local reference.

challenge.method: Compared OSI records 406 and 546 at the opening notice, section 1(c) and final numbered section. Checked whether CMS publication status itself assigns local active status.
challenge.results: Record 406 uses the ordinary OSL notice, refers to this Open Software License in section 1(c), and ends at section 16. Record 546 expressly adds a Non-Profit Amendment. CMS status=publish confirms publication only.

limitations: Active is the proposed local reference state. The scope document supplies the admission rule, without recording a prior selection of this entity. A specific work’s grant, reuse, installation and approval history require separate evidence.
reasoning: OSI publishes ordinary OSL 3.0 as a distinct license with its own application notice and grant. The Index can use this publication as an active reference within its stated taxonomy.
